prompt: Nora booked two places. Gusts prevent kite flying, and Nora plans to miss the demonstration. How can her companion attend alone and later have the option of a replacement session?
promptZh: Nora 預約了兩個名額。陣風妨礙放風箏，而 Nora 不會參加示範。她的同行者如何能單獨參加示範，之後還能選擇改約戶外場？
evidence: anyone who attends indoors can choose a replacement outdoor session when new dates open
A companion can come on their own only if the holder has told us their name before the session.

options.text: By showing the forwarded message while Nora keeps the name private.
options.zh: 出示轉寄通知，且 Nora 不提供同行者姓名。
options.why: A forwarded message does not meet the advance name requirement.
options.whyZh: 轉寄通知不符合事先告知姓名的要求。

options.text: By attending the demonstration after Nora gives the club the companion’s name.
options.zh: 等 Nora 向風箏社告知同行者姓名後，單獨參加示範。
options.why: Advance naming enables solo attendance, and attending preserves that visitor’s outdoor option.
options.whyZh: 事先提供姓名後，同行者可以單獨到場；參加室內場也可保留改約戶外場的資格。

options.text: By turning up after the demonstration and returning a kite.
options.zh: 示範結束後才到場，並歸還一個風箏。
options.why: This does not count as attendance; indoor visitors do not borrow the kites.
options.whyZh: 這不算參加示範，室內場也不出借風箏。

options.text: By arriving anonymously and asking to split the reservation.
options.zh: 不具名到場，並要求將預約分開。
options.why: The person attending alone must have been named before the session.
options.whyZh: 單獨到場的同行者必須事先登記姓名。
